stories.title: First South Korean container ship departs on journey via Northern Sea Route
stories.summary: SEOUL, August 22. A container ship of South Korea’s Panstar company has set sail for Europe from the South Korean port of Busan via the Northern Sea Route, the Yonhap news agency reported. The ship left the port at noon GMT. It will be the first journey via the Arctic route for a Korean commercial vessel. The entire mission is expected to take 45 days. The Northern Sea route will make South Korean deliveries to Europe approximately 7,000 kilometers and ten days shorter, compared to the traditional Suez Canal route.

stories.title: Russian forces strike two trains transporting military cargo in Ukraine
stories.summary: MOSCOW, August 22. Russian drones have hit two Ukrainian trains transporting military cargo in the Dnepropetrovsk region of Ukraine, the Russian defense ministry said. The ministry published "footage of Geran drones hitting two rail locomotives used for delivering cargo for the armed forces in Ukraine near the settlement of Nikolayevka in the Dnepropetrovsk region.".
